author: FractalDataWorks
name: Reference service domain (ServiceTypeCollection + configuration providers)
description: A ServiceTypeCollection domain with the two-tier configuration provider pattern: a domain provider over the shared DomainConfiguration row, and one implementation option with its own ManagedConfiguration and implementation provider, registered the way the FDW-727 domains are. Covers configuration only — see the README for the scoped service-provider layer.

DomainCategory.description: The ServiceCategory this domain registers under — becomes the PlatformServices accessor name, the domain's schema and table name, and the ConfigurationCommands TypeOption name. Matches the generated project name by default.

ImplementationOption.description: The Implementation discriminator for the one example implementation this template generates — becomes its [Implementation] name and its typed body's ManagedConfiguration ServiceType. A real domain has more than one; add siblings by copying SampleImplementation/ under a new discriminator.

EventIdBase.description: First EventId for this domain's MessageLogging (domain + implementation share one contiguous range of 20). Must not collide with an existing range — see RESULTCODE-CATALOG.md.
